metadata.title: Size-3 Condorcet winning sets for 7 and 8 candidates: exact SAT certificates with LRAT proofs
metadata.description:
Machine-checked certificates that every election with 7 or 8 candidates and any number of voters (strict rankings) has a Condorcet winning set of size 3, in the sense of Elkind, Lang and Saffidine (2015): for every outside candidate c, fewer than n/2 voters rank c above every member of the set. For odd n this follows from Elkind, Lang and Saffidine (2015), Corollary 1; the even-n cases are new as exact results. A counterexample to the size-3 conjecture of Charikar et al. (STOC 2025) therefore needs at least 9 candidates.

Contents: CNF generators with exact rational Farkas-core checks, the cores, an independent second generator for each case, per-cube hashes, 21 CaDiCaL LRAT proofs for m = 8 (5.05 GB zstd) and one for m = 7 (55 MB xz), all verified with the formally verified checker cake_lpr, and verify.sh, which regenerates every CNF and rechecks every proof. MANIFEST.sha256.ots anchors the hash of MANIFEST.sha256 in Bitcoin block 969212 (2026-09-29 22:18:32 UTC), which proves the manifest existed by that block's time; matching hashes tie the proofs and CNFs to that manifest.

The certificates were found, built and checked by AI agents at IRSI (Anthropic Claude and OpenAI Codex models) under the direction of Peter Seelman. Not peer reviewed.
metadata.notes: Verify: ./verify.sh (about 25 CPU-minutes, 30 GB RAM). Manifest sha256 ae319c72fe646532c836856be0f86572b8c92d10b84c6de9050815d572c77555.
